done: Added the single pinned dependency "react-native-css-interop": "0.2.6" to packages/docs-snippets/nativewind/package.json and proved RED→GREEN via a real copy-outside-monorepo consumer bundling run (expo export --platform web: exit 1 'Unable to resolve react-native-css-interop/jsx-runtime' → exit 0, 3083 modules, css-interop hoisted at 0.2.6), with the uniwind template and repo-root pnpm-lock.yaml byte-unchanged.
deviations: The contract's literal proof command `cp -R packages/docs-snippets/nativewind/.` omits the shared/ overlay that app/index.tsx imports, so a clean GREEN is unreachable via that literal path; I followed ORI-RN-003's prepareConsumer order instead (copy the 12 template files → run the verbatim recipe → THEN overlay app/index.tsx + shared/*).
Evidence was committed under .tmp/FIX-ORI-RN-003-1/cycle-1/{red,green}/ per the task-level instruction, not under tests/sprint-05-orient-search/evidence/FIX-ORI-RN-003-1/ as TC-3 names it.
concerns: The recipe runs `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` under set -euo pipefail, so if app/index.tsx is copied BEFORE the recipe runs, tsc fails on the unresolved @/shared/quickstart-screen import and aborts — the entrypoint+shared overlay must always follow the recipe.
findings: Hoisting confirmed: pre-fix pnpm nests react-native-css-interop@0.2.6 under node_modules/.pnpm/nativewind@4.2.6_…/node_modules/ and never hoists it; post-fix it is hoisted to the consumer root at exactly 0.2.6 (npm latest is 0.2.7, which nativewind@4.2.6 does not pin).

The bundling proof requires the overlay-order preparation; ORI-RN-001's quickstart-consumer.ts copies only the 12 template files and only typechecks, so a bundling re-run must use ORI-RN-003's native-session.ts prepareConsumer.
biome.json's includes do not match packages/docs-snippets/** so biome ci on the template reports no files processed; the effective lint gate is pnpm lint (biome ci .).
